# TEKOKU SIGNS! "COUNT US PROPERLY!"

In Atiaiaba the queues to sign Senator Lessa's petition stretched around the cathedral square. A Capital Party senator, of all people, has said what THE WATCHMAN has said for years: the North pays, the North is outvoted. Deputy Henrick Daur called it "the first honest proposal from St. Veldra in a generation". The palace was not available for comment. The palace rarely is, north of the river.
